# V2 artifact sidecar: code quality review, round 1

Verdict: **FAIL (static review)**.

Reviewed frozen round-1 changes in `/workspace/android-studio-source-providers`, based on `ac58815bb268d338bea40a31fff630734cd719f4`. No Cargo, compiler, Gradle, application, formatter, cache mutation, source modification, or subagent dispatch occurred. Tests and strict Clippy have not been executed; this verdict does not claim compilation or runtime success.

## Blocking finding

**Q1 — Format the newly added test helper assignment.** `crates/android_tools/tests/generated_artifacts.rs:533` contains `let paths=invalid[...]`. This lacks the normal Rust spaces around `=` and needs the repository formatter; the chain should be formatted according to `rustfmt.toml` (edition/style edition 2024). The source is therefore not ready for the required formatting gate. Run the formatter when authorized, retain every assertion and test, freeze the corrected source, and re-run quality review. Do not suppress formatting or remove the duplicate-map-key case to obtain a pass. This is a static source finding; no formatter failure has been manufactured or counted as an executed gate.

## Additional likely Clippy issue

`crates/android_tools/tests/generated_artifacts.rs:250–252` declares an explicit `'a` only to connect the sole borrowed input with the output. Rust lifetime elision expresses the same contract: `fn main_artifact(snapshot: &GeneratedArtifactSnapshot) -> Result<&android_tools::generated_artifacts::GeneratedArtifact>`. Prefer that signature. This may be diagnosed by `clippy::needless_lifetimes`; confirm with the required `./script/clippy --locked -p android_tools` after the root grants its exclusive lease. The workspace explicitly allows the `style` group, `type_complexity`, and `large_enum_variant`, so no findings are made merely for those categories. No Clippy diagnostic or pass is claimed here.

## Reviewed quality and test coverage

- The additive `generated_artifacts` module is a separate logical component and uses the descriptive Zed crate root through the existing `android_tools.rs`. Cargo manifests, dependencies, lockfile, public Basic model structs and existing tests are unchanged.
- Production fallible paths return the existing typed `FactsUnavailable` result. There are no new production `unwrap`, `expect`, unchecked array indexes, ignored fallible operations, asynchronous jobs, filesystem scans, or GUI callbacks. Bounds and getters are checked before access. Negative-test `unwrap_err` assertions are intentional assertions on failure behavior.
- Description-bearing record equality stays distinct from numeric comparison. Neither version type implements an inconsistent `Ord` contract. Signed `i32` values retain the original Kotlin `Int` domain.
- Both complete original ordering methods preserve the nine original tuples, every description, signed minimum/maximum, reversed input and final ordered full-record equality. Explicit `sort_by(compare_version)` is the Rust adaptation of the original comparison semantics. The remaining original `checkSupportsParallelSync` method is retained in the attributed source and has not been claimed as ported.
- All 24 additive tests remain declared, with no new ignore/skip attributes. Boundary coverage includes producer-versus-AGP feature gates, legacy alpha07 classpath support, malformed and unproved versions, available-empty/absent/unavailable distinctions, raw encounter order and duplicate paths, schema/root/module/variant contradictions, stale revisions, minimum consumer compatibility, Java-specific field shapes, duplicate SDK map keys and the 16 MiB record guard. Runtime evidence is still required, especially current-bridge SDK probes; synthetic DTO tests cannot establish real BuildConfig behavior.
- The Gradle extension uses official SDK tooling-model queries and distinct capability capture fields. Rust owns feature policy and decoding. The existing JVM model getter exception is unchanged. Current-bridge compatibility, process cleanup and exception behavior still need actual SDK probes.
- The complete pinned `BasicModules.kt` and `ModelVersionsTest.kt`, original Apache headers, license and NOTICE are retained and hash-matched. No canonical parity matrix rows were changed. Raw V2 folders remain explicitly separate from Studio generated-root visibility filtering, Kotlin facets, selection and UI flows.

## Source identity and preservation

Rehashed all eight review source files at the beginning and end of review; all match `review-source-snapshot.json`. Rehashed all **184 immutable original files**, **31 cited reference files**, and **11 historical probe files**; all match `baseline-guard.json`. Historical SDK probes were identity-checked only and are not current-source gate evidence. The only changed pre-existing tracked files are the authorized module export and Gradle bridge. No original test, fixture or canonical matrix was deleted, weakened or skipped.

## Required follow-up

Fix Q1 without changing assertion meaning and address the elidable lifetime if applicable. Preserve this FAIL report. After corrected source is frozen, request the affected quality review again. Actual full AndroidTools tests, normal locked build, repository strict Clippy, formatting, matching-source SDK probes and the root's full-app/CI/parity gates remain pending. Neither the task nor Phase 1 is complete on the evidence reviewed here.
